lines.text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God,
as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
so pursue them with Your tempest,
and terrify them with Your storm.
that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
May they be ever ashamed and terrified;
May they know that You alone,
are Most High over all the earth.

pictures.scene: Eastman Johnson, Winnowing Grain — the grain poured out of the basket so the wind carries the chaff away, make them like tumbleweed O my God, like chaff before the wind
pictures.name: pd_johnson_winnowing

pictures.scene: Alexey Denisov-Uralsky, Waldbrand — the forest burning with its smoke standing up over the hills, as fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze
pictures.name: pd_denisov_waldbrand

pictures.scene: Józef Chełmoński, Thunderstorm — the herd driven in panic and the people bent double as the lightning comes down, so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm
pictures.name: pd_chelmonski_burza

pictures.scene: Francisco Pradilla, La Rendición de Granada — the beaten king riding out with the keys of the city he has lost, cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name O LORD
pictures.name: pd_pradilla_granada

pictures.scene: Lucas van Valckenborch, The Tower of Babel — the huge unfinished tower and the man who ordered it built, may they be ever ashamed and terrified, may they perish in disgrace
pictures.name: pd_valckenborch_babel

pictures.scene: François Diday, Paysage alpestre au lac — the one great mountain standing up alone in the evening gold, may they know that You alone whose name is the LORD
pictures.name: pd_diday_alpestre

pictures.scene: Harald Sohlberg, Winter Night in the Mountains — the snow peaks and the one star standing over the whole still earth, are Most High over all the earth
pictures.name: pd_sohlberg_vinternatt
